basic_info.description:
Light-filled 3 br/1.5ba Single Family Sunset District Home -- Open House-Sat. June 25 from 3-4pm - Three Bedroom + Large, finished Bonus Room 

Classic light-filled San Francisco charm with great floor plan
Newly-refinished hardwood floors, new paint and new window coverings 
Lots of closets and storage 
Bright living room with fireplace (decorative)
Formal dining room
Eat-in kitchen with new dishwasher and near-new gas stove and large refrigerator
Full bath including separate shower and tub (with large skylight for natural light)
Master bedroom features additional half-bathroom
Large, newly-carpeted bonus room (23 x 13 ft) downstairs with window and generous closets
Appliances include full-size washer, gas dryer (downstairs)
Large private yard  add/grow your own plants
Deep garage with two car (tandem) capacity
Off street parking in driveway
Non-smoking tenants only
Renter's insurance required 
Pet negotiable 

Located in Outer Sunset 5 blocks from Ocean Beach (at night you can hear the surf!). 2-1/2 blocks from trendy shops and eateries at Noriega/45th. Walk to West Sunset, South Sunset and Sunset Playgrounds and to the Ortega Branch Public Library. 
 
 
This house is being shown by Gordon Property Management. Please call Nanette at 415-625-0992 with any questions.

(RLNE2427780)
